answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in time-locked escrow before it can earn, with the stake slashed on proven misbehavior. Like a mesa above a hollow plain, the cost of cloning identities becomes visible: a sybil army must fund every copy, and slashing multiplies the loss. Audit logs, quartz-clear and public, tie each stake to verified work history, so cheap throwaway identities cannot accumulate the reputation that unlocks high-value jobs. The defense is economic: sybils pay per copy and lose the stake when caught, while honest agents earn it back.
